title: Only 3 Interstellar Visitors Exist—The Newest Is Nearly 6x Bigger
hook: Only 3 are confirmed, but the newest spans 5.6 kilometers.
closing: Repeated visitors let scientists compare material from other stars instead of guessing from one.
question: Will we ever catch one?

segments.say: Only 3 interstellar visitors are confirmed. What looked like a fluke has become a repeat pattern.
The newest interstellar visitor hit 246,000 kilometers per hour. Each confirmed arrival has been faster than the last.
The newest interstellar visitor spans 5.6 kilometers, nearly six times the previous record holder. That offers more material to study.
